name: Memory & Visualization
description: Blindfold chess board visualization, spatial mental models, working memory capacity, and recall.

dimensions.name: Blindfold Board & Coordinates
dimensions.description: Instantly identifying square colors (e.g., e4 is dark), diagonal intersections, and knight paths.

rubricCriteria.90-100: Instant recall of square colors, diagonal trajectories, and 3-step knight routes.
rubricCriteria.70-89: Accurate calculation within 2 seconds of mental pause.
rubricCriteria.50-69: Struggles with board orientation; confuses ranks and files.
rubricCriteria.0-49: Complete spatial disorientation; cannot visualize square colors or paths.

dimensions.name: Blindfold Piece Tracking
dimensions.description: Tracking moves without a physical board over 5-10 move sequences without losing piece states.

rubricCriteria.90-100: Tracks multiple moving pieces across 8+ plies without losing square occupancy.
rubricCriteria.70-89: Maintains position up to 5 moves before needing a position recap.
rubricCriteria.50-69: Loses track of subtle piece displacements after 3 moves.
rubricCriteria.0-49: Visualization breaks down after 1-2 moves; ghost pieces hallucinated.
